description: Rust-red floor-length tailored overdress over cream underdress visible centrally and at elbow-length sleeves, low square neckline. Fine gold woven geometric borders at neckline, sleeves, waist and front skirt edges, small round belt fittings with hanging ends, cream-lined red wrap around forearms, small pendant and earrings. One dark leather shoe visible below hem; other largely covered. Both hands visible in front. No headgear, armor or weapon.
